note: ip2country maps an IP to an ISO country code from its own {ip2country} table (loaded from RIRs) and stores each user's country in user.data (ip2country/country_iso_code_2) on login. Config object ip2country.settings keys: rir, update_interval, batch_size, md5_checksum, watchdog, debug, test_type, test_country, test_ip_address. Services ip2country.lookup (getCountry) and ip2country.manager (updateDatabase/emptyDatabase/getRowCount). Drush ip2country:update|lookup|status. Configure route ip2country.settings (/admin/config/people/ip2country), permission 'administer ip2country'. On this test site the {ip2country} table is not populated (no live RIR download), so all medium/hard cases are grounded in the ip2country.settings config values, not in real IP lookups. Medium cases seed known settings and read them back; hard cases set settings (registry/interval, debug spoofing), verified against live config.

evals.prompt: On a Drupal site with ip2country enabled, which service and method would you call to get the ISO country code for a given IP address, and what does it return when the IP is not found?
evals.expected_output: Call the ip2country.lookup service's getCountry($ip) method (Ip2CountryLookupInterface). It returns the ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code, or FALSE when the IP is not found in the {ip2country} table (including when the table has not been loaded yet).

evals.prompt: Where does the ip2country module store a user's detected country, and when is it written?
evals.expected_output: On hook_user_login it stores the detected ISO country code in the core user.data service under module 'ip2country', key 'country_iso_code_2'. hook_user_load copies it back onto $account->country_iso_code_2. Read it with \Drupal::service('user.data')->get('ip2country', $uid, 'country_iso_code_2').

evals.prompt: Which Drush command refreshes the ip2country IP-to-country database, and how do you tell it which Regional Internet Registry to use?
evals.expected_output: drush ip2country:update (aliases ip-update / ip2country-update) truncates and reloads the {ip2country} table. Pass --registry=<all|afrinic|apnic|arin|lacnic|ripe> to choose the RIR (default 'all'); also --batch_size and --checksum. drush ip2country:status shows the last update; drush ip2country:lookup <ip> looks one up.

evals.prompt: On this Drupal site, ip2country has been configured with a non-default source registry and update interval. Inspect the live configuration and report the RIR (registry) and the update interval in seconds.
evals.expected_output: ip2country.settings has rir = 'ripe' and update_interval = 86400 (one day).

evals.prompt: This site's ip2country database-update settings have been customized. Inspect the running configuration and report the batch size and whether MD5 checksum verification is enabled.
evals.expected_output: ip2country.settings has batch_size = 500 and md5_checksum = true.

evals.prompt: Configure ip2country on this Drupal site to pull its IP/country data from the APNIC registry and to auto-update every two weeks (1209600 seconds). Apply the change to the live site.
evals.expected_output: Set ip2country.settings rir = 'apnic' and update_interval = 1209600 and save (e.g. \Drupal::configFactory()->getEditable('ip2country.settings')->set('rir','apnic')->set('update_interval',1209600)->save()).

evals.prompt: For testing, configure ip2country on this site so that an administrator logging in is treated as being located in Germany (country code DE), using the module's debug/spoofing feature in country-spoof mode. Apply the change to the live site.
evals.expected_output: In ip2country.settings set debug = true, test_type = 0 (country spoof), and test_country = 'DE', then save. On login an admin with 'administer ip2country' is then treated as being in DE.
